title: DiallelAnalysisR
text: Performs Diallel Analysis R using Griffing’s Hayman’s approaches. Four different Methods (1: Method-(Parents + F1’s + reciprocals); 2: Method-II (Parents one set F1’s); 3: Method-III (One set F1’s reciprocals); 4: Method-IV (One set F1’s )) two Models (1: Fixed Effects Model; 2: Random Effects Model) can applied using Griffing’s approach.
